questions.prompt: Explain why it is important that ORS is mixed with exactly the amount of water written on the packet.
questions.modelAnswer: ORS works only at the right concentration of salts and sugar. With too little water the solution is too concentrated; this can draw water out of the body into the gut and worsen dehydration. With too much water it is too dilute to replace the lost salts effectively. The packet is designed so that its fixed mass of solute in the stated volume gives the correct concentration.
rubric: Concentration must be correct to work
Too dilute does not replace salts enough
